name: deallocate
declaration: unsafe fn deallocate (& mut self , elem_layout : Layout)
documentation:
# Safety

 This function deallocates the owned allocation, but does not update `ptr` or `cap` to
 prevent double-free or use-after-free. Essentially, do not do anything with the caller
 after this function returns.
 Ideally this function would take `self` by move, but it cannot because it exists to be
 called from a `Drop` impl.
rules: After `deallocate` returns, the `RawVecInner` instance must not be used again: its owned allocation has been deallocated, but its `ptr` and `cap` remain unchanged, so subsequent use must not cause double-free or use-after-free.
